insights.one_liner: alfa1 group is a Veldhoven-based group of IT, engineering and consulting brands with 300+ people in seven countries; not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: A family of nine specialist brands (such as merapar, blupoint and group9) with 300+ professionals in seven countries.
Names reliability, passion and care as its values and says it aims for an inclusive environment.
Staff often come from HAN, Avans and Fontys universities of applied sciences, in business, IT and electronics.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, an entry-level data role in Veldhoven, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in 2021 as a group bringing together existing brands; privately held.
